## Summary

Describe the problem & resulting behavior.

## Changes

- Describe the material changes.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the repository's documented tests, formatting, security checks, & build where applicable.
- [ ] I added or updated meaningful tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I updated public documentation & the changelog when users are affected.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff for secrets, personal data, private paths, internal systems, & private project-management information.
- [ ] I confirmed that any new dependency is necessary, maintained, & licence-compatible.

## Related Public Issue

Link a public GitHub issue when one exists, for example `Fixes #123`.

## Screenshots Or Evidence

Add public-safe evidence when it helps reviewers assess the change.
